title: The Solar System
intro: The Sun sits at the center, with eight planets traveling around it on their own orbit paths.
summary: Planets closer to the Sun are rocky and small, while the outer planets are much larger gas and ice giants. The Sun and the distances are shrunk to fit the model, but the order of the planets and their sizes relative to each other are kept.
photo: A real photo of the solar system is not one picture. Astronomers' images show the Sun as a bright ball of light, the inner planets as small dots, and the giant planets as large bright spheres, with Saturn's rings clearly visible.

parts.label: The Sun
parts.say: The star at the center. It holds about 99.8 percent of the solar system's total mass.

parts.label: Orbit paths
parts.say: The circular paths each planet follows around the Sun.

parts.label: Inner rocky planets
parts.say: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are small and rocky, closest to the Sun.

parts.label: Jupiter
parts.say: The biggest planet. It is about 11 times wider than Earth.

parts.label: Saturn
parts.say: Famous for its flat rings made of ice and rock.

parts.label: Uranus
parts.say: An ice giant that spins almost on its side.

parts.label: Neptune
parts.say: The farthest planet from the Sun, with very strong winds.
